title: 蓋を開いた部品洗浄槽
description: 工場・自動車整備室の作業背景に置く部品洗浄槽。深さのある空槽と金属縁、すき間のある洗浄ラック、開いた蓋・蝶番・支持棒、四脚と下棚、ポンプ外形・固定ノズル・ブラシホース、下部排水栓外形を造形。洗面台とは異なる部品洗浄設備として一式1点。液体・洗剤・部品は含まず、洗浄・給排水・電装・安全性能を実装または検証した機器ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.946 × 1.580 × 0.823 m、7,968三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An open-lid parts washer for industrial and vehicle-service workshop backgrounds. It has a genuinely recessed empty basin/metal rim, open-bar washing rack, hinged lid/support stays, four legs/lower shelf, pump exterior/fixed nozzle/brush hose and closed lower drain exterior. It is one parts-cleaning assembly rather than a washbasin. Fluid, chemicals and workpieces are absent; cleaning, plumbing, electrical and safety performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.946 × 1.580 × 0.823 m; 7,968 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
